jonny-desktop.task: vanguard-web: replace Phaser.Scale.FIT with integer-multiple scaling + letterbox, so rendered pixels are never resampled to fractional size (BRIEF.md milestone 1 remainder)
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED TO ORIGIN. vanguard-web main @ 365311e, clean tree, tracking origin/main. Integer canvas scaling enforced, completing BRIEF.md milestone 1. Root cause was two-layered: Phaser.Scale.FIT stretched the canvas to fill #game, and #game was width min(94vw,1024px) - at 1024 that is 1024/384 = 2.667x, so image-rendering:pixelated gave some source pixels 3 screen pixels and their neighbours 2. Uneven grid on essentially every window size, unfixable downstream by any sprite work. Now Phaser.Scale.NONE + computed integer zoom, recomputed on resize, letterboxed; #game no longer sets a width (a width is a target for Phaser to stretch to, which caused this). VERIFIED IN-BROWSER not by reasoning: 1280x720 -> zoom 3, displayed 1152x648, scale exactly 3.000 both axes; fresh load at 1000x700 -> zoom 2, displayed 768x432, fits viewport. Backing store stays 384x216 so captures are unaffected - confirmed by re-running the harness: all 10 files byte-identical to the committed baseline, which also proves the harness works as a regression detector. Build clean, 22 tests green, no stray .js. BRIEF.md §1 rewritten from 'must be fixed' to 'must stay that way' and §8 gained a checkable criterion (rect.width/canvas.width is an integer and equals the height ratio at every window size) so it is verified rather than eyeballed. MILESTONE 1 NOW COMPLETE: harness + baseline + integer scaling. RECOMMENDED NEXT: milestone 2 - shading.ts derivation layer and Maren rebuilt - behind its five-condition gate. Nothing rendered could be judged fairly before this commit; now it can.
